current_contract_summary.ready_contact_rule: A person row can be READY/high_trust_usable only when person, title, organization, source, and usable contact evidence are field-supported. Public corporate contact channels alone are not person-contact evidence.

field_mapping.rule: State is target scope, not proof of a state-level IT decision maker.
Must be source-supported for person_lead, organization_only, not_found, and failed rows.
Useful context, but not itself a readiness signal.
Use to separate public corporate contact rows from person leads.
Only valid for person_lead when it is a real person, not a department, role, company, or generic contact channel.
Must be current or explicitly source-supported; older public references should remain REVIEW until refreshed.
Blank is allowed. Non-empty values require verified_found or deduced_with_pattern_evidence. No guessed, private, stale, unsupported, or placeholder emails.
Person-level phone only counts when source-supported for that person. Main corporate phone maps to org contact context, not READY contact support.
Do not treat as person phone unless the source ties it to the person.
Generic media/info/contact emails do not make a person CRM-ready.
Can support name, title, and organization after fetch/access validation.
Supports corporate channel availability, not person contact readiness by default.
verified_current means source currency only; it must not automatically map to READY.
Useful blocker/evidence note; should become field-level validation notes with checked_at.

requested_shape_to_contract_outcome.contract_outcome: Mostly organization_only or not_found unless a state-specific retail IT person is supported by public evidence.
requested_shape_to_contract_outcome.risk: The transcript pivoted away from this target, so White Rabbit should preserve missing/not_found rows instead of hiding the miss.

requested_shape_to_contract_outcome.contract_outcome: review/manual_lookup person_lead rows when name/title/org/profile are supported but direct person contact is missing; high_trust_usable only where person-level email/phone evidence exists.
requested_shape_to_contract_outcome.risk: Volume can look good while contact yield stays below the product gate.

requested_shape_to_contract_outcome.contract_outcome: review or failed until current title/organization is rechecked.
requested_shape_to_contract_outcome.risk: Old official sources are still official but may be stale.
Current export has fields for email/phone; filling them with generic channels would create false CRM confidence.
